knowledge.note: To learn a card: own its book, have discovered its items (if any), read it (cost.read = Time Quiz questions of reading, faster with library levels), then answer its quiz: newQuestions about the card + up to maxReviewQuestions from cards it builds on (weakest or longest-unseen first; one per card). Wrong answers can be retried; only first-try answers move a card up a Leitner box. A missed review never blocks — that card just comes back sooner. Cards unlock things (anything that lists them in requires), give a permanent boost (effects), or both.

quiz.note: Time Quiz questions come from the parent's question packs; knowledgeReviewShare of them (0–1, a setting) are due reviews of knowledge cards the child already learned (spaced repetition). 0 turns reviews off.
